mapper.select:
SELECT d.id AS id, d.job_name AS jobName, d.job_desc AS jobDesc, d.mode AS mode, d.job_type AS jobType, d.client_id AS clientId, d.job_version AS jobVersion, d.source_type AS sourceType, d.source_table AS sourceTable, d.source_datasource_id AS sourceDatasourceId, d.sink_datasource_id AS sinkDatasourceId, d.sink_type AS sinkType, d.sink_table AS sinkTable, d.release_state AS releaseState, d.create_time AS createTime, d.update_time AS updateTime,
s.id AS scheduleId, s.cron_expression AS cronExpression, s.schedule_status AS scheduleStatus, s.last_schedule_time AS lastScheduleTime, s.next_schedule_time AS nextScheduleTime, s.schedule_config AS scheduleConfig,
i.job_status AS lastJobStatus, i.start_time AS lastStartTime, i.end_time AS lastEndTime, i.error_message AS errorMessage, i.run_mode AS runMode, i.id AS instanceId,
CASE WHEN i.start_time IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN i.end_time IS NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, i.start_time, NOW()) ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, i.start_time, i.end_time) END AS duration,
(IFNULL(m.read_qps, 0) + IFNULL(m.write_qps, 0)) AS qps, m.read_row_count AS readRowCount, m.write_row_count AS writeRowCount, m.read_qps AS readQps, m.write_qps AS writeQps, m.record_delay AS recordDelay,
ds_source.name AS sourceDatasourceName, ds_sink.name AS sinkDatasourceName
FROM ( SELECT * FROM t_baize_flow_job_definition
AND id = #{query.id}
AND job_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.jobName}, '%')
AND create_time >= #{query.createTimeStart}
AND create_time <= #{query.createTimeEnd}
AND source_type = #{query.sourceType}
AND sink_type = #{query.sinkType}
AND source_table LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.sourceTable}, '%')
AND sink_table LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.sinkTable}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize} ) d LEFT JOIN t_baize_flow_job_instance i ON i.id = ( SELECT t1.id FROM t_baize_flow_job_instance t1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT job_definition_id, MAX(start_time) AS max_start_time FROM t_baize_flow_job_instance GROUP BY job_definition_id ) t2 ON t1.job_definition_id = t2.job_definition_id AND t1.start_time = t2.max_start_time WHERE t1.job_definition_id = d.id ORDER BY t1.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN t_baize_flow_job_metrics m ON i.id = m.job_instance_id
LEFT JOIN t_baize_flow_job_schedule s ON d.id = s.job_definition_id
LEFT JOIN t_baize_flow_datasource ds_source ON d.source_datasource_id = ds_source.id
LEFT JOIN t_baize_flow_datasource ds_sink ON d.sink_datasource_id = ds_sink.id
AND i.job_status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY COALESCE(i.start_time, d.update_time, d.create_time) DESC, d.update_time DESC, d.id DESC
